description: This file defines the GatewayManager class responsible for managing gateway addresses in the Orleans distributed application framework. It handles retrieving, refreshing, and maintaining a list of known and live gateways, along with marking gateways as dead or unavailable. The class includes mechanisms for periodic updates, synchronization, and connection management to ensure reliable gateway communication.

classes.name: GatewayManager
classes.description: Manages the list of gateways for the Orleans client, including fetching, refreshing, and marking gateways as dead or unavailable. Implements periodic updates and connection management to ensure consistent communication with active gateways.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, retrieves the initial list of gateways, and starts the periodic refresh timer.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the periodic gateway refresh timer and waits for ongoing refresh tasks to complete.

methods.name: MarkAsDead
methods.description: Marks a specified gateway as dead and updates the cached lists accordingly.

methods.name: MarkAsUnavailableForSend
methods.description: Marks a specified gateway as temporarily unavailable for sending messages.

methods.name: GetLiveGateway
methods.description: Selects a live gateway using round-robin tuning for new message routing.

methods.name: GetLiveGateways
methods.description: Returns the current list of live gateways, initiating an update if the list is empty.

methods.name: IsGatewayAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a given gateway is currently known as live.

methods.name: ExpediteUpdateLiveGatewaysSnapshot
methods.description: Triggers an immediate refresh of the live gateway list asynchronously.

methods.name: PeriodicallyRefreshGatewaySnapshot
methods.description: Continuously refreshes the gateway list based on a timer until stopped.

methods.name: RefreshGatewaySnapshot
methods.description: Performs the gateway list refresh via the provider and updates internal state.

methods.name: UpdateLiveGatewaysSnapshot
methods.description: Processes a new list of gateways, filters out dead ones, updates cache, and manages connections.

methods.name: CloseEvictedGatewayConnections
methods.description: Closes connections to gateways that are no longer active.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources, mainly the refresh timer.
